text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the day of the Tenno Sho 
(Spring). The 3,200m long distance is a 
true challenge for Ikuno Dictus.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing in her way is Mejiro McQueen. As 
an Umamusume of the Mejiro family, winning 
the Shield— the Tenno Sho holds a special 
significance for her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Given this distance, Mejiro McQueen—being 
a stayer—arguably had the advantage. 
However, she was not taking anything for 
granted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus welcomes Mejiro McQueen's 
blazing fighting spirit. The heated Tenno 
Sho (Spring) now begins—!
